google.title: Google & dual accounts (personal and school)
google.desc: Manage your two accounts separately: personal for Google Drive, Calendar and Tutor; school email for notices from lecturers.
google.personalOptional: Optional · Connect only to import from Drive or Calendar
google.personalInfo: Optional: reads the Google Drive folders you link to your courses and imports Google Calendar events. To sign in to Unipedia, we recommend email and password under Account.
google.cleanupTitle: Removes invoices, receipts and personal files imported by mistake
google.academicOptional: Optional · Any school or personal Google email
google.academicInfo: Reads lecturers' notices about rooms, tests and timetables straight from your school inbox, read-only.
google.tokensInfo: Read-only access. Access tokens live only in memory and sessionStorage and are never saved to public databases.
google.offBody: Events imported from Google Calendar will be removed from the app. Your Google accounts stay unchanged.

data.cleared: Data deleted from this device. Your settings are kept.
data.demoLoaded: Sample semester loaded (you can clear it any time).
data.title: Backup & data
data.intro: Save everything to a portable JSON file or try the app with a sample semester. Your Gemini key is never exported.
data.clearInfo: Clear only this device, or open the portal to delete your cloud account.
data.demoTitle: Replace current data with the sample?
data.demoBody: You already have courses on this device. Loading the sample semester replaces your current local data. Export a JSON backup first if you want to keep it.
data.clearBody: This removes courses, assessments, classes, sessions, tasks, materials and events stored on this device. Export a backup first if you need one.

err.pasteEmpty: No classes found in that content. Open the Timetable in your university portal, select all (Ctrl/Cmd+A), copy (Ctrl/Cmd+C) and paste here.
err.htmlEmpty: No classes found on that page. Save the Timetable page from your academic portal (Ctrl/Cmd+S) and pick that file.
err.icsEmpty: No events found in this file. Check it's an .ics exported from your portal or calendar.

importSchedule.title: Import timetable
importSchedule.step1: Open the Timetable in your university portal.
importSchedule.pasteHere: Click here and paste the timetable
importSchedule.icsIntro: Export your academic calendar as .ics and upload it here. Recurring classes go into the timetable and exam dates become assessments.
importSchedule.textIntro: One class per line (weekday names in Portuguese). Examples:
importSchedule.replaceWarn: Importing replaces what was previously imported from the portal (classes, assessments and events). Data from other sources stays as is.
importSchedule.noCourses: You have no courses yet. Create them in Courses before importing.

card.title: Import timetable and grades
card.desc: .ics calendar or timetable page from your university portal.
card.body: Quickly import your calendar file (.ics) or paste the timetable from your university portal to fill in classes and exams.
card.how1: Export your timetable as .ics or copy the table from your academic portal.
card.how2: Tap “Import timetable” and pick the file or paste the text.
card.how3: Confirm the course for each class and import without losing the rest of your data.

gemini.advanced: Advanced: use a personal key (AI Studio) or change model
gemini.optional: Optional: for heavy use without the daily limit of {{chatLimit}} messages/{{nbLimit}} notebooks, you can paste a free key from
